page_title: MON 2-2 HEI | B. Monchengladbach v Heidenheim 04/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Diant Ramaj displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
90+2' Hugo Bolin (B. Monchengladbach) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Diant Ramaj easily deals with the threat.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' A brilliant individual effort! Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
85' Shuto Machino will be replaced by Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
83' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Diant Ramaj has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
80' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' Heidenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
79' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Diant Ramaj intercepts the ball.

66' Good work from B. Monchengladbach as they win a corner.
63' 1 - 2 Goal! Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:2.
63' Eugen Polanski has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Wael Mohya.

57' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) sends an accurate short pass. Mathias Honsak controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
55' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
51' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
49' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Diant Ramaj has no trouble gathering it.
49' Hennes Behrens (Heidenheim) is being substituted because of an injury. Frank Schmidt sends Leonidas Stergiou on the pitch.
47' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
44' It's a nice effort by Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Moritz Nicolas. Easy save.
44' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
42' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
41' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging some short passes.
40' A toe poke from Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim) heads right for the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is well placed and makes a good save.

32' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
29' The foul by Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) was seen by Bastian Dankert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
